triples.tail_surface: placed or protected as to minimize the likelihood of sustaining damage from the accumulation of dust, oil vapors, steam or dripping liquids, or from activities around their location
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 合理布置或防护以避免积尘、油雾、蒸汽、滴液或周边活动造成的损坏
triples.evidence_text: Control equipment and instrumentation are to be so placed or protected as to minimize the likelihood of sustaining damage from the accumulation of dust, oil vapors, steam or dripping liquids, or from activities around their location.

triples.head_surface: electronic equipment associated with control and monitoring systems
triples.head_canonical_zh: 控制与监测系统电子设备
triples.evidence_text: For the selection and installation of electronic equipment associated with control and monitoring systems, a temperature range of 5°C (41°F) to 55°C (131°F) is to be considered for machinery space, control rooms, accommodations and navigation bridge.

triples.head_surface: equipment located inside panels or cubicles
triples.tail_surface: consideration is to be given to the temperature rise inside those panels due to the dissipation of heat from its own components
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 考虑柜内因元件散热引起的温升
triples.evidence_text: When equipment is located inside panels or cubicles, consideration is to be given to the temperature rise inside those panels due to the dissipation of heat from its own components.

triples.head_surface: equipment associated with automatic or remote control and monitoring systems
triples.head_canonical_zh: 自动或远程控制与监测系统设备
triples.tail_surface: installation ... in areas of unusual electromagnetic sources is to be avoided
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 避免安装在异常电磁源区域
triples.evidence_text: In general, the installation of equipment associated with automatic or remote control and monitoring systems in areas of unusual electromagnetic sources is to be avoided.

triples.tail_surface: appropriate measures are to be implemented to reduce the effects
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 实施适当措施以降低影响
triples.evidence_text: Where the values per 4-9-9/15.7 TABLE 1 may be exceeded, appropriate measures are to be implemented to reduce the effects of electromagnetic and conducted interference.

triples.tail_surface: Installation of equipment in locations where ambient temperature fluctuations can lead to accumulation of moisture condensation inside equipment enclosure is to be avoided unless the equipment is protected by, for instance, space heaters, or such equipment is to be designed and constructed to function in this environment
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 避免安装在易凝露位置或使用空间加热器保护或采用适应该环境的设计
triples.evidence_text: Installation of equipment in locations where ambient temperature fluctuations can lead to accumulation of moisture condensation inside equipment enclosure is to be avoided unless the equipment is protected by, for instance, space heaters, or such equipment is to be designed and constructed to function in this environment.

triples.head_surface: electromagnetic noise caused by circulating currents
triples.tail_surface: the conductive shield and cable armor is to be grounded only at one end of the cable
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 导电屏蔽层和电缆铠装仅在电缆一端接地
triples.evidence_text: To avoid electromagnetic noise caused by circulating currents, the conductive shield and cable armor is to be grounded only at one end of the cable.

triples.tail_surface: signal cables occupying the same cable tray, trunk or conduit with power cables are to be effectively shielded
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 与电力电缆共用桥架、管道或线槽的信号电缆应有效屏蔽
triples.evidence_text: To avoid possible signal interference, signal cables occupying the same cable tray, trunk or conduit with power cables are to be effectively shielded.
